title: Terrence Malick
idiom: Edward Hopper-style gouache — wide desolate landscape at magic hour, a lone figure silhouetted against a luminous sky, the horizon low, space doing the speaking
hero_prompt: Wide ~12:5 scene in Edward Hopper gouache style: a lone small figure stands in a vast open field at magic hour, golden light raking across tall grass from low on the horizon, the sky massive and softly lit, the figure's back to the viewer, watching — no faces visible, no portraits, purely the feeling of patience and awe before the natural world; hand-painted medium, visible brushwork, warm amber and deep blue tones, no letters, numerals, words, labels, or text of any kind — purely pictorial
icon_prompt: Bold high-contrast square emblem in screenprint style: a single tree silhouette at magic hour, sun just below the treeline casting a starburst of rays upward, stark black tree against deep orange-gold background — no fine detail, no linework, just flat-cut shapes that survive at 24px; no letters, numerals, words, or labels
